label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Dear neighbors,

I’m writing to every unit at Larkspur Lofts because I want to address the note that appeared in the lobby about a drone flown from the roof deck. I’m in 5A, and I’ve lived here for three years.

On Saturday, October 31, around 4 p.m., I flew a new drone—a Halvard Mini 4—from the roof deck for about 11 minutes. I’m a wedding photographer, and I was testing it before a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge the entire time. It was not aimed at any windows, and I did not record anyone in the building.

I understand why it looked bad. A drone buzzing over the courtyard is strange if you don’t know what’s happening, and I’ve heard it frightened a neighbor’s grandchildren. I’m sorry for that. I should have thought more about how it would appear from the ground.

If anyone wants to see what the drone actually captured, I’m glad to show you the full unedited clip. Knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

I also want to say calmly that finding my unit number posted publicly next to the word “creep” was upsetting. I understand concern, but that felt like being singled out in front of the building. Going forward, I’d ask that neighbors come talk to me directly if something I’m doing worries them.

Our HOA rules do not currently address drones. I won’t fly from the roof again until the board takes this up, and I’ll ask them to add it to the November 19 board meeting agenda at 7 p.m. in the community room. I’d welcome that conversation.

Thanks for reading.

Jess Okafor  
Unit 5A
